layout: 32 azimuths stacked vertically (row a*256 + r), azimuth a = a*360/32 deg clockwise from north
source: Terrain horizons from the LOLA global DEM (32 azimuths, 40 steps to 200 km, DEM down to level 7, observer 2 m; inside the polar caps (|lat| > 80.3 deg) heights from the LOLA polar DEMs LDEM_80S_80M / LDEM_80N_80M)
